Name: iHateVanillaRugs (only kinda)
Author: n0vacanes
Description:
this mod adds 24 wider rugs to the game!

included are:
[list]
[*]wider blossom rug (improved 2.0.0 extra wide version!) in vanilla (green), sakura pink, seafoam green, starry blue, daisy yellow, and purple
[*]wider large oval rug in vanilla (red), gray, grey, purple, teal, and stormy blue
[*]wider large rug with pattern in vanilla (green), blue, gray, pink, purple, and red brown
[*]wider large rug edited to a more plain style in vanilla (green), blue, gray, pink, purple, and red brown
[/list]can be obtained from the furniture catalog and robin's shop! two file versions are available - one with the rugs available in both robin's shop and the furniture catalogue, and one with the rugs only available in the furniture catalogue for those who don't want a cluttered shop menu :)


this is my first mod so if there's anything super messed up please let me know :33
